Intermediate.learningGoal: Design classes for constructor injection and compose them by hand (no container).
gotchas: new-ing dependencies inside the class makes it untestable
Constructors doing work beyond assigning fields
goodSolutionShows: All dependencies visible in the constructor
Composition in one place (a composition root)
Interfaces only where a second implementation or a test double is needed
shapeHints: a notification service needing a clock, a sender and a template store
refactoring a class that calls DateTime.Now and new HttpClient()

Advanced.learningGoal: Understand lifetimes by building a tiny DI container (singleton, scoped, transient).
gotchas: Captive dependency: a singleton holding a scoped/transient service
Circular dependencies must be detected, not stack-overflow
goodSolutionShows: Cycle detection with a clear error
